# PiTTy 0.6.44

## Extension model settings

- Settings now has **Compaction model**. It picks the model `pi-one-round-compaction` uses for the next compaction and writes the setting to `one-round-compaction.json` in the Pi agent directory.
- Settings now has **Subagent models**. It lists shared defaults plus every discovered `@mistrjirka/pi-subagent` profile with its effective model, thinking level, and where the value comes from. A new choice applies to the next spawned child.
- Picking a model preserves everything PiTTy does not own: thinking levels, compaction lane overrides, and unrelated keys. Writes are atomic, and a malformed configuration file is reported instead of being overwritten.
- When a project-level `.pi/` configuration already overrides the value, PiTTy updates that file; otherwise it updates the global configuration.
- The compaction summary marks lane overrides, so a top-level model change is not confused with the model a lane actually uses.

## Recommended packages

The installers now offer the current recommended set:

```bash
pi install git:github.com/mistrjirka/pi-subagent
pi install git:github.com/mistrjirka/pi-one-round-compaction
pi install npm:@juicesharp/rpiv-todo
pi install npm:pi-web-access
pi install npm:pi-diet-semble
pi install npm:pi-hermes-memory
```

- `pi-hermes-memory` is now recommended. PiTTy already uses it for the Memory browser, but the installers used to only detect it.
- `pi-mcp-adapter` remains supported and can still be installed from Settings > MCP servers, but it is no longer offered automatically.

Run `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.44` to stage the release. It activates on your next PiTTy launch.
